'''Shelaan Lazari''' was the first king of [[Arad Doman]].

== History ==
Shelaan Lazari was the second son of [[Jalaam Lazari]], one of the three nobles who had founded the nation of Arad Doman in c. {{fy|1096}}. In {{fy|1116}}, Shelaan was made the first King of Arad Doman.
